item.title: SCP *PLACE HOLDER NUMBER* The Bee movie.
item.description: This is my very first draft of an SCP, I want to know what y'all think of it.
item.content:encoded:
For context before we get into the meat of this thread, I was inspired to write this because I've often heard the bee movie be described as a collective fever dream, I feel like it could fit into the joke scp category, but I think with more tweaking it could be a full fledged article.

Scp 9999 The Bee movie.

Object class: Safe.

Special containment procedures:

Due to the circumstances surrounding SCP 9999 full scale containment as of this moment is both impossible and unnecessary. Personnel are instead instructed to avoid viewing SCP 9999, MTF-PHI 22 “Fever Dreamers” is to be alerted to any devices reported to contain a recording of SCP 9999, recordings are to be either destroyed or given directly to Director McKinley for [DATAEXPUNGED]. If any personnel should happen to view SCP 9999 they are instructed to avoid telling others about it or posting about it on social media in order to attempt to slow the spread of its anomalous effects.

Description:

SCP 9999 is the official designation for a viral phenomenon which causes the victim to hallucinate having viewed a computer animated movie from 2007 called The Bee Movie which stars comedian Jerry Seinfeld. Those affected usually have wildly different experiences in regards to SCP 9999, with some reporting that the film they watched was a romantic comedy, while others report that the film they watched was a surreal horror film, in spite of this however four factors remain constant.

Number one: the main character is always voiced by Jerry Seinfeld.

Number two: the main character will attempt to sue the human race over their consumption of honey.

Number three: the love interest of the main character will always be human.

Number four: the film will always end with The main character and the love interest opening a joined flower shop/law firm.

Although the foundation has managed to create a ‘dummy film’ and amnestise most of those who have been affected by SCP 9999, there remain a few affected individuals who further propagate the effects of SCP 9999.
